messages.content: What documents are needed to verify a field instrument loop?

Typically: approved P&ID, instrument index, instrument datasheet, I/O list, loop diagram, cable schedule, JB schedule and termination drawings, system architecture, hook-up drawing, area classification documents, control narrative/cause-and-effect where applicable, and project instrumentation specifications. The exact document set is project-dependent.
Should an AI model decide the SIS wiring architecture automatically?

No. It can help organize requirements and identify review questions, but SIS architecture and wiring must be determined and approved through the project's functional-safety lifecycle by qualified personnel. Verify independence, segregation, voting, diagnostics, proof-test requirements, applicable standards and approved safety requirements specifications.
